On October 28th, 2026 Can-Do Kalamazoo is launching a series of pop-up events for our entrepreneurs to sell their food, products, and services to the Kalamazoo community. Scout new catering options for your holiday parties Discover new products before the season of gifting Enjoy a drink and check out Can-Do Kalamazoo’s new event space

events.title: Vicksburg/Schoolcraft Business Community Townhall
events.description: Vicksburg/Schoolcraft Business Community Townhall 108 S Main St Vicksburg, MI Tuesday, September 29 • 8:30 AM – 10 AM Overview Let’s come together for a lively community discussion on boosting local businesses and creating a thriving environment for all! Join the Southwest Michigan First Chamber for the upcoming Vicksburg/Schoolcraft Business Community Townhall! This is your chance to connect with local city and community leaders, share your insights, and explore opportunities that shape the future of the Vicksburg/Schoolcraft area. Together, let’s spark collaboration and work toward meaningful progress for our community. Topics may include: Economic and community development updates Upcoming construction projects and infrastructure improvements Events and initiatives driving foot traffic Safety, accessibility, and parking updates Open Q&A with city and community leaders Bring your ideas, your challenges, and your neighbors—we’ll supply the refreshments and an open, welcoming platform for discussion. We look forward to seeing you there! About the Southwest Michigan First Chamber The Southwest Michigan First Chamber is dedicated to fostering the connection, development, collaboration, and growth of the small business community and its leaders throughout greater Kalamazoo County. The Chamber supports the mission of Southwest Michigan First not only in its support of the creation of well-paying jobs, but also through the strengthening of our existing small business community. A strong small business presence is a proven key attractor for new businesses and a reason why families, existing companies, and their employees want to stay here.

events.title: Lunch with Entrepreneurs and Business Owners / Almuerzo Con Emprendedores Y Dueños De Negocios at El Concilio
events.description: ¡QUEREMOS ESCUCHARTE! ALMUERZO CON EMPRENDEDORES Y DUEÑOS DE NEGOCIOS DE KALAMAZOO El programa Camino al Éxito de El Concilio invita a los emprendedores y propietarios de negocios de nuestra comunidad a compartir un almuerzo y participar en un espacio de diálogo abierto. Queremos escuchar sus experiencias, conocer sus necesidades, entender los desafíos que enfrentan y descubrir cómo podemos continuar apoyándolos para fortalecer y hacer crecer sus negocios. ¡Tu voz es importante! Este encuentro es una oportunidad para compartir ideas, expresar inquietudes y contribuir a la creación de nuevas oportunidades para nuestra comunidad empresarial. Fecha: Sábado 31 de octubre de 2026 Hora: 12:00 p.m. a 1:30 p.m. Lugar: El Concilio 2501 Millcork St, Kalamazoo, MI 49001 INSCRIPCIÓN OBLIGATORIA El almuerzo es gratuito, pero es indispensable registrarse previamente para participar. Regístrate aquí: https://forms.gle/gKQeBkn7ctw346FLA ¡Queremos conocer tu historia, escuchar tus ideas y trabajar juntos por el éxito de nuestros negocios! Organiza: Programa Camino al Éxito de El Concilio WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU! LUNCH WITH ENTREPRENEURS AND BUSINESS OWNERS OF THE KALAMAZOO COMMUNITY The El Concilio’s Path to Success program invites entrepreneurs and business owners from our community to share a lunch and participate in an open dialogue. We want to hear your experiences, understand your needs, identify the challenges you face, and discover how we can continue to support you in strengthening and growing your businesses. Your voice matters! This meeting is an opportunity to share ideas, express concerns, and contribute to creating new opportunities for our business community. Date: Saturday, October 31, 2026 Time: 12:00 p.m. to 1:30 p.m. Location: El Concilio 2501 Millcork St, Kalamazoo, MI 49001 Mandatory Registration Lunch is free, but registration is required to participate. Register here: https://forms.gle/gKQeBkn7ctw346FLA We want to hear your story, listen to your ideas, and work together for the success of our businesses! Organized by: El Concilio’s Path to Success program

events.title: Conectar para Crecer: The Power of Relationships, Community, and Opportunity at Casa di Amici
events.description: Conectar para Crecer: The Power of Relationships, Community, and Opportunity – Wed, November 11 @ 5:30 pm–8:30 pm – Registration Required. Join us in understanding that networking is more than exchanging business cards, it is about building meaningful relationships, sharing experiences, opening doors, and creating opportunities for one another. This interactive roundtable will explore the impact that intentional connections can have on our personal and professional growth, particularly within the Latino community. Participants will have the opportunity to: Share personal stories Discuss barriers that make networking difficult or uncomfortable Explore ways we create welcoming and inclusive networks Leave motivated to intentionally build and strengthen their professional and personal networks Together, we will consider not only learn how to expand our own circles, but how we can use our connections, knowledge, and experiences to uplift others who may not yet feel connected. This in-person event has limited capacity. The location will be sent in a calendar invitation prior to the event. We will be in Kalamazoo County for planning purposes. We also expect this event to reach capacity, so please let us know if your plans change and you can no longer attend. Facilitated by: ELLAS Event Categories: Adult, ONEplace, Registration Required Venue Casa di Amici

events.title: Startup Zoo Pitch Night
events.description: Pitch your project, idea, or business for funding and resources. Five finalists are selected to compete for $10,000 in equity-free capital! Every other month, five (5) businesses will pitch live to three (3) judges for $10,000 in equity-free capital, partnership, customers, and free resources to start or grow their idea. Attendees can engage and vote for their favorite pitch. The People’s Favorite walks away with $1,000. Register to RSVP, bring a friend, vote, and support your local entrepreneurs! 2026 dates are as follows: Jan. 16, March 13, May 15, Sept. 21 and Nov. 13 6 – 8 p.m. Please note: All events except Sept. 21 take place at StartUp Zoo. Sept. 21 will be at the Kalamazoo Institute of Arts as part of the Startup Zoo Southwest Michigan Entrepreneurship Summit.
